atmosphere_source: provisional Tier-C broadband mapping anchored to NASA POWER UVA/UVB climatology; full libRadtran LUT corpus pending
definition: 99.9th percentile of modeled naturally occurring daylight melanogenic-effective irradiance in the reference corpus
site_list: subtropical: Casa de Campo DO (18.4N, humid)
high latitude: Tromso NO (69.6N, low sun)
arid high sun: Alice Springs AU (23.7S, high aerosol variability)
high albedo: Davos CH winter snow (46.8N, albedo 0.8)
status: PROVISIONAL - stratified estimate, not the final multi-year libRadtran corpus. Any recalibration creates a new score model version; never silently change.
temporal_sampling: solstice/equinox midday + diurnal sweep per site across clear/cloudy/aerosol/ozone states (analytical provisional); full multi-year corpus pending libRadtran training/LUT build

empirical_two_site_grounding.method: Tier-C E_mel over pooled daylight training climatology (NASA POWER UVA/UVB, south-bend + pacific-palisades, ghi>10 & sza<90)
empirical_two_site_grounding.note: Temperate/subtropical sites only (max UVI ~11-12 in tables); unsampled equatorial/high-altitude extremes justify headroom above the pooled p99.9.
